Most of my friends hated on this game because it looks like it was made for the Playstation 3. And I've convinced every single one of them to give it a try and they all loved it. 

It's a giant monster third person shooter, and it has 4 distinct classes that each have their own style of play and weapons. Teamwork is essential for higher difficulties and in my opinion that's where this game really shines. The harder the difficulty you play on the better your weapon drops will be and with each better weapon their ridiculous meter gets higher and higher. Weapons range from machine guns to rockets to laser rifles to giant punching fists to Japanese love pillows to intercontinental ballistic missiles to giant fighting mechs. The list goes on and on, and if you're even slightly interested by that description you should give it a try. It's excellent!

The actual most exhilarating, fun, and amazing time I have had in a videogame in so many years. 

With a market saturated with the non-stop run of the mill shooters. Earth Defense Force 5 stands out as a beacon of hope in our dark world of greedy, AAA, rushed, garbo games.

The game may not have the most amazing graphics, but the fun gameplay more than makes up for it

You get the option of playing as 1 of 4 classes. Each with their own benefits, strengths, and utility. And each with tier own weaknesses.

1.) Wing Diver
[Pros]
- Incredibly high mobility (best and typically the fastest)
- Has great damage 
- Great diversity of weapons suited for all situations
[Cons]
- Unreasonably squishy (you will almost always have less health than every other class, lowest armor box to health conversion)

2.) Fencer
[Pros]
- Very good mobility regardless of what he seems like (access to multiple dashes and boosts which make him the second most mobile character in the game)
- Extremely tanky (highest armor box conversion to health)
- Great fighting styles available because of having a weapon slot in each hand (Melee/Shield, Gun/Shield, Gun/Gun, Melee/Melee, etc.)
[Cons]
- Slow start (low mobility and health)
- Melee builds can easily be cucked in later missions

3.) Ranger
[Pros]
- Good in almost every aspect due to his wide variety of weapons (ARs, Shotguns, Grenades launchers, tracking missiles, etc.)
- Access to sprinting (not as fast as Wing Diver or Fencer, but still decent)
[Cons]
- Body armor is better in most situations making the vehicles Ranger has not worth to use (mostly opinion though)

4.) Air Raider (my one and only boi)
[Pros]
- The best AOE damage in the game via airstrikes (takes some practice
- Access to three weapons and a vehicle (has a crazy selection of vehicles to choose from)
[Cons]
- The most immobile class in the game
- Air Raider's good weapons are highly not suited for point blank range (Limpet guns are mediocre at best, you cant change my mind)

But don't let those descriptions change what you might pick in the game. I thought I was going to main Wing Diver, but loved Air Raider so much. Play with everything and find out what suits you best.

So if you want so amazing, unadulterated fun, get this game when you can. The 60$ is so worth the amount of fun you'll get with a wild and crazy 111 mission campaign.

Hopefully you'll pick this game up and share in the fun that is Earth Defense Force 5. 

E D F!


Final Mission Spoiler. For people who have already beat the game or if you dont care about spoilers.
[spoiler]Using a mech the size of skyscraper to punch god in the face so hard he explodes. A true EDF5 experience.[/spoiler]
The first mission is a absolute drag but once you get farther the more insane the game gets. Ive always beena big fan of the EDF series and this one is my top favorite by far.

This entry to the EDF series builds on everything I loved about the previous title, and I loved every minute of it. 
The only thing that hurts a little is the removal of Fencer dash-cancelling. However, the added movement mods add enough that it doesn't seriously hamper how much I love being a giant metal boy with two giant metal guns.

I'm doing my part, are you?
